contract: CONNECTTRUTH CONN-05 (Phase 240 plan 03) - the PERMANENT 400 body on the LIVE key-connect route (POST /api/validate-key). Every case below is the EXACT wire body the Python service emits for a credential-class refusal: a FLAT object whose top-level `detail` is a SCALAR string, plus a machine `code` and a boolean `recoverable` that is false on every case here (a permanent verdict: retrying the same credentials cannot succeed). The scalar `detail` is the load-bearing half and is byte-identical to the bare `{detail}` body these arms answered before the code was added: src/lib/analytics-client.ts does `error.detail ?? "Analytics service error"` and src/lib/wizardErrors.ts `classifyKeyValidationError` branches on body.code first and falls back to a SUBSTRING CASCADE over that message, so a reworded detail would move a rendered verdict.
notes: COMMITTED, never generated, written by hand from the literal strings. The `python` and `frontend` jobs in ci.yml are siblings with no `needs:` edge, so a file one job writes is invisible to the other. The Python consumer asserts these bodies equal what the REAL route emits through the REAL main.app exception-handler stack. The TypeScript consumer asserts the wizard verdict for each body equals the verdict for the HEAD-shape body (the same detail with no code and no recoverable), so adding a code moves no rendered copy and no Retry control. Neither consumer may derive its expectations from the module under test: every value here is a literal. Synthetic values only; no credentials, no tenant data. This is a SEPARATE file from validate_key_venue_transient_contract.json, whose TypeScript reader asserts one status (424) across all of its cases.
invariants: status is 400 on every case. These are CALLER-REQUEST faults (a credential the caller sent was refused), unlike the 424 venue-transient class in validate_key_venue_transient_contract.json.
body key set is EXACTLY {detail, code, recoverable} - no more, no fewer.
body.detail is a scalar JSON string, byte-identical to the copy these arms answered before the code was added. A reword is a CROSS-LANGUAGE breaking change.
recoverable is false on every case: a permanent credential verdict.
consumers: analytics-service/tests/test_validate_key_permanent_400.py - asserts each body equals a REAL full-stack TestClient(main.app) response at the site named by site_id
tests/lib/validate-key-permanent-400-parity.test.ts - asserts the wizard verdict for each body equals the verdict for the HEAD-shape body, over these same bytes
